title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Whisk the eggs and mix with Parmesan cheese.
Combine the spaghetti, bacon, and egg mixture. Serve with black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate the chicken with yogurt and spices for at least 2 hours.
Grill the chicken until fully cooked.
In a pan, sauté onions and tomatoes until soft.
Add cream and the grilled chicken to the pan, and simmer for 10 minutes.
